notes:
1) checkApproval now writes on a detached, bounded ctx: github.go:417 `context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), approvalWriteTimeout)`, and the timeout is 10 s. The CancelFn call is kept at github.go:412. Met.
2) There is only one copy of checkApproval. Both callers are in pollForApproval (github.go:359, github.go:370). Fresh-request polls start at github.go:348; rehydrate creates its pollCtx at github.go:225. Both use the same code. The webhook path (github.go:494) still passes the caller's ctx. Met.
3) RecordDecision now treats a lost race and a write failure differently. Any error other than ErrApprovalAlreadyDecided is logged at WARN and returned before the entry is deleted (manager.go:517-523). "race lost" is logged at INFO only for ErrApprovalAlreadyDecided (manager.go:536-538). Met, with the ErrNoRows side effect above.
4) The github_test detached-ctx test is TestCheckApproval_RecordsDecisionOnDetachedContext. Its fake recorder returns ctx.Err() and the test asserts DecisionApproved plus the waiter's Response. It uses a fake recorder, which matches the contract being guarded: store.go:1984 `s.db.ExecContext(ctx, ...)` fails on a cancelled ctx. Met.
5) The rehydrated-path test builds its entry through the real `h.Rehydrate` (github.go:179-239) and then wraps CancelFn. Met.
6) The Manager tests cover both cases: a plain error keeps the entry and logs WARN; ErrApprovalAlreadyDecided removes it and logs race lost. The existing test at manager_test.go:792 was switched to the real sentinel. Met.
7) Out of scope: no change to the poll interval, timeout or default_action. Persistence from #5764 and the Slack/Telegram handler code are unchanged; the one shared-behaviour change is the ErrNoRows defect above.
8) Project memory pitfalls: none of the three (CI-failure misclassification, StageReleasing guard, studio-sdk branch fallback) applies to this diff.
